reapack.desc: Wwise Transfer (send REAPER audio to Wwise)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Preview is now a Wwise-style tree: containers and Sounds nested as they'll appear in Wwise, with type, New/Exists status and Sound counts. Expand all / Collapse all buttons and a count of new objects.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Much faster in big Wwise projects: the existing-object check only asks about the objects being transferred. REAPER stays responsive while the window talks to Wwise (calls run in the background). The transfer summary shows how long each step took.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed a command prompt window flashing open and closed over and over while the window is open. The Wwise selection is now read when you switch back to the window (or with the Refresh button), not on a timer.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: REAPER no longer hangs after a transfer while Wwise is still busy with the import. The preview remembers what already exists in Wwise and only asks Wwise again when something changes. The preview never waits on Wwise for more than a moment; if Wwise is busy it tries again a few seconds later.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New Settings button (top right) with the connection, render and after-transfer preferences, so the main window is less crowded. Rendering preferences, "Apply property templates" and "Select in Wwise afterwards" moved into Settings. New layout: setup on the left, a bigger Wwise preview on the right, Transfer button under the preview. Each structure level's property template, move and remove options are in its "..." button.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed: with "Always use the object selected in Wwise" on, the destination stayed empty (and Transfer greyed out) until you left and came back to the window. When the Transfer button is greyed out, the bar next to it says why (and so does its tooltip).

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed REAPER freezing for about 2 minutes after a transfer: big replies from Wwise (like the import's) made the script wait until a timeout. Fixed an "@-001"-style folder appearing in the Originals subfolder path. Settings > Diagnostics: a log of slow moments (what the script was doing and for how long) to track down freezes. With "Always use the object selected in Wwise" on, the Sounds the transfer selects in Wwise no longer become the next import destination.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Switching project tabs with the window open now loads that project's settings (before, the window kept showing and saving the previous project's).

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Fixed "Not connected to Wwise" (curl error 26) in 1.5.3.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New: "Set Initial Delay from layer timing". Select all your layers; each layer's start offset within its shot becomes the Initial Delay of its layer container (or of each Sound). Shown in the preview, applied on transfer, or right away to objects already in Wwise.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Preview: new "Originals file" column (the file name Wwise will store in Originals). Right-click a column header to choose which columns are shown; the choice is remembered. Settings: background opacity slider for the window. Settings: "Keep rendered files in" folder for item renders (relative to the project folder, wildcards allowed). Empty keeps the old behaviour (temporary files). Preview: "Collapse all" now folds the containers that hold Sounds, so the container layout stays visible. Settings: clearer wording for when property templates are applied.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Window opacity at 100% is now fully solid (ImGui's default background is slightly see-through). Popups are solid too.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Preview: Status shows New in green and Exists in orange. Cleaner one-line header: status dot, Wwise project and version on the right next to Refresh and Settings. Connection problems show as a banner. Preview: the Type column is gone; hover over a row's [tag] (or its name) to see its type. Originals subfolder: new Browse button opens a folder picker in the Wwise project's Originals folder. Typing and wildcards still work.
